glosses: To laugh or giggle in a somewhat subdued or restrained way, as from nervousness or poorly-suppressed amusement.

examples.text:
1863, Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, Tales of a Wayside Inn Part First: The Sicilian's Tale - King Robert of Sicily
A group of tittering pages ran before.
